content.text: Buraco (also known as Canastra, Biriba, or Perida) is a four-player partnership card game from Brazil related to Canasta. Players meld sequences of three or more consecutive cards of a suit, aiming to create canastas (sequences of 7+ cards). The game uses two 52-card decks with four jokers (108 cards total).

Buraco originated in the Rio de la Plata region of South America (Argentina and Uruguay) in the 1940s and remains widely played in Brazil. It is closely related to Canasta and similar to Samba in its melding mechanics. In Brazil the game is also known as Canastra, Biriba, or Perida in different regions.
4 players in two fixed partnerships (partners sit opposite)
